content: The text provided is a detailed list of medical conditions, classifications, and codes related to congenital abnormalities, perinatal conditions, and birth-related injuries, as outlined in the ICD-10 (International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision) system. 1. Abnormalities of Sex Chromosomes: Female phenotype abnormalities not classified elsewhere (Q98). Male phenotype abnormalities not classified elsewhere (Q99). Other chromosomal abnormalities not classified elsewhere. 2. Congenital Syphilis (A50): Early congenital syphilis with symptoms (A50.0). Early congenital syphilis, latent (A50.1). Early congenital syphilis, unspecified (A50.2). Congenital syphilis, unspecified (A50.9). 3. Congenital Viral Diseases (P35): Congenital rubella syndrome, including rubella pneumonitis (P35.0). Congenital cytomegalovirus infection (P35.1). Congenital herpes simplex infection (P35.2). Congenital viral hepatitis (P35.3). Other congenital viral diseases, such as congenital varicella (P35.8). Unspecified congenital viral disease (P35.9). 4. Other Congenital Infectious and Parasitic Diseases (P37): Congenital tuberculosis (P37.0). Congenital toxoplasmosis, including hydrocephalus due to toxoplasmosis (P37.1). Congenital falciparum malaria (P37.3). Other congenital malaria (P37.4). Other specified congenital infectious and parasitic diseases (P37.8). Unspecified congenital infectious and parasitic disease (P37.9). 5. Infections Specific to the Perinatal Period (P39): Intra-amniotic infection of the fetus, not classified elsewhere (P39.2). Other specified infections specific to the perinatal period (P39.8). Unspecified infection specific to the perinatal period (P39.9). 6. Fetal Blood Loss (P50): Blood loss from vasa praevia (P50.0). Blood loss from ruptured cord (P50.1). Blood loss from placenta (P50.2). Hemorrhage into co-twin (P50.3). Hemorrhage into maternal circulation (P50.4). Blood loss from the cut end of co-twin’s cord (P50.5). Other fetal blood loss (P50.8). Unspecified fetal blood loss (P50.9). 7. Intracranial Non-Traumatic Hemorrhage in Fetus and Newborn (P52): Grade 1 intraventricular hemorrhage (subependymal hemorrhage without intraventricular extension) (P52.0). Grade 2 intraventricular hemorrhage (subependymal hemorrhage with intraventricular extension) (P52.1). Grade 3 and 4 intraventricular hemorrhage (subependymal hemorrhage with intraventricular and intracerebral extension) (P52.2). Unspecified intraventricular hemorrhage (P52.3). Intracerebral hemorrhage (P52.4). Subarachnoid hemorrhage (P52.5). Cerebellar and posterior fossa hemorrhage (P52.6). Other intracranial hemorrhages (P52.8). Unspecified intracranial hemorrhage (P52.9). 8. Hemolytic Disease of Fetus and Newborn (P55): Rhesus isoimmunization (P55.0). ABO isoimmunization (P55.1). Other hemolytic diseases (P55.8). Unspecified hemolytic disease (P55.9). 9. Hydrops Fetalis Due to Hemolytic Disease (P56): Due to isoimmunization (P56.0). Due to other or unspecified hemolytic disease (P56.9). 10. Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation (DIC) in Fetus and Newborn (P60). 11. Other Perinatal Hematological Disorders (P61): Congenital anemia due to fetal blood loss (P61.3). Other congenital anemias not classified elsewhere (P61.4). Other specified perinatal hematological disorders (P61.8). Unspecified perinatal hematological disorder (P61.9). 12. Birth Injuries: Intracranial lacerations and hemorrhages due to birth injury, including subdural, cerebral, intraventricular, subarachnoid, and tentorial tears (P10). Other birth injuries to the central nervous system, such as cerebral edema and spinal cord injuries (P11). Birth injuries to the scalp, including cephalhematoma, chignon, and bruising (P12). Birth injuries to the skeleton, including fractures of the skull, femur, clavicle, and other long bones (P13). Other specified and unspecified birth injuries (P15). 13. Congenital Malformations: Malformations of the ear, face, neck, heart, respiratory system, digestive system, genitalia, urinary system, musculoskeletal system, and skin (Q16–Q89). Specific syndromes such as Down syndrome (Q90). 14. Disorders Related to Fetal Growth and Gestation: Slow fetal growth and malnutrition, including light-for-gestational-age and small-for-gestational-age infants (P05). Disorders related to prolonged gestation and high birth weight (P08). 15. Other Conditions Originating in the Perinatal Period: Congenital renal failure (P96.0). Complications of intrauterine procedures (P96.5). Other specified and unspecified conditions originating in the perinatal period (P96.8, P96.9).
